cards.notes: Reserve a friendly queen, then detonate around the target queen at the next owner turn start.

cards.scope: current most-captures removal
cards.notes: Remove one of the pieces with the highest capture count; royal excluded.

cards.scope: current pawn leap over a blocker without capture
cards.notes: Pawn may advance over an occupied square but may not capture that way.

cards.scope: current delayed lobster spawn on an empty square
cards.notes: Reserve an empty destination, then spawn the lobster after the delay.

cards.scope: current double-monster promotion
cards.notes: A promoted pawn may become two friendly monsters when space allows.

cards.scope: current four-turn revival of a captured piece
cards.notes: Revive a captured friendly piece on a chosen friendly pawn for four plies.

cards.scope: current 3x3 royal zone around the enemy king
cards.notes: Mark the 3x3 around the enemy king as the palace zone.

cards.scope: current ordered deferred move declaration
cards.notes: Up to three ordered moves resolved after the opponent's next move, with no captures.

cards.scope: current non-royal major transformation
cards.notes: Convert a chosen non-royal major into a random transformed piece.

cards.scope: current first-moved pawn turn refund
cards.notes: The first friendly pawn to move after a pawn is captured does not spend the turn.

cards.scope: current opposite-colour arrival ban
cards.notes: While all friendly pieces share one square colour, enemies may not land on the other colour.

cards.scope: current weakest-moved-enemy conversion
cards.notes: Convert the weakest enemy piece that has already moved.

cards.scope: current four-turn inactivity purge
cards.notes: After four turns remove every non-king piece that did not move.

cards.scope: current per-turn-end random removal from both sides
cards.notes: At every turn end remove one random piece per side.

cards.scope: current forced enemy king move
cards.notes: The opponent's next move must move the king.

cards.scope: current turn-end trapped-piece conversion
cards.notes: At turn end convert enemy pieces caught between two friendly pieces.

cards.scope: current three-turn pawn conversion to vip
cards.notes: Convert a chosen pawn into a vip after three owner turns if it survives.
